title: Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.00084v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. translated_title: 科学智能体：评估面向特定职业的系统提示词在科学任务上的效果
translated_abstract: 详细的专业特定系统提示词会增加令牌使用量和每次回复的预估成本，却无法带来一致的准确率提升。我们评估了“科学智能体”，这是一个包含503个面向特定职业的AGENTS.md配置文件的开源语料库，通过OpenRouter在Pi智能体框架中使用Gemini 3.8 Flash进行测试。我们将匹配的配置文件与四种对照条件进行比较：极简基线（“你是一个乐于助人的助手”）、配置文件的开头角色句、通用科学严谨性指南，以及来自无关领域的配置文件。在九个基于文本的科学基准测试中（4,531个抽样问题，100个匹配的配置文件），经过API错误重试后，共有4,488个条目完成了全部五种条件，并采用自动化的基于规则的评分方式。配置文件与基线之间的平均准确率差异为-0.6个百分点（在固定任务上的95%自助法置信区间为[-1.5, +0.2]），且没有任何基准测试显示出统计上明确的改进。匹配的配置文件产生的输出令牌数量是基线的1.5-2.3倍。
tldr: 该研究通过在九个科学基准上对503个职业专属系统提示词与多种对照条件进行大规模对照实验，发现详细的专业提示词相比极简基线并不能提升科学任务的准确率，反而使输出令牌消耗增加1.5-2.3倍，表明此类精细提示词的成本收益并不划算。
en_tdlr: Large-scale controlled experiments across nine science benchmarks show that detailed profession-specific system prompts yield no statistically clear accuracy improvement over a minimal baseline while consuming 1.5-2.3 times more output tokens, indicating an unfavorable cost-benefit tradeoff.
